benchmark.prompt: The product launch area inside an industrial equipment expo has a low platform, with a knee-high commercial floor-cleaning robot at its center, a rounded metal body, exposed circular brushes beneath the front edge, and a small upright control screen. Beside the platform, a presenter in a plain suit extends an open hand toward the robot, while a staff member pulls a large cloth away from its body, the cloth still hanging over the rear corner and gathering in folds across the platform. Buyers wearing blank badge holders stand around the platform with sample brochures in their hands, a visitor raises a phone toward the reveal, and behind them neighboring exhibition booths contain shelving, equipment displays, and people moving through the wide aisle.

benchmark.prompt: Early-2000s LAN party in a village community hall at night, long folding tables, chunky beige CRT monitors and tower cases side by side, a tangle of gray Ethernet cables running along the floor to a blue network switch taped to a table leg. Teenagers in hoodies wear headphones, two lean over one screen pointing; pizza boxes and soda cans stack between keyboards, sleeping bags rolled under chairs. A paper banner on the back wall reads "FRAG NIGHT". Cable routing should be logical, screens glow while the hall stays dim, faces and hands natural.
